pages.text: Tier 1 bosses are found in Overworld structures. They are manageable in iron/copper gear but require active dodging. None drop Simply Swords uniques — those begin at Tier 2.

$(bold)Mutant Zombie$() (Mutant Monsters)$(br)Overworld surface + structures. Drops: $(item)Hulk Hammer$() (25%, fun T1 melee drop with custom stats: 20 attack damage, 0.5 attack speed, Knockback II, +50% vs undead), Uncommon Ink (20%), Blood Rune (10%).$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$() (Mutant Monsters)$(br)Overworld surface. Drops: Uncommon Ink (20%), Ice Rune (10%).$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Creeper$() (Mutant Monsters)$(br)Overworld surface. Drops: Uncommon Ink (20%), Fire Rune (10%).$(br2)$(italic)Note: Mutant Monsters crafting recipes are stripped -- you cannot craft armor/tools from drops. The Hulk Hammer + rune/ink drops are the intended T1 reward path.$()
